Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Suresh - 30 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Sanjay - 26 years, friend
Look: glasses, brown sweater
3. Neeta - 56 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The hospital ward - Day

[Suresh is asleep in bed in the ward. Sanjay stands near him.]

Sanjay: "Today feels like a good day."

[After a long illness Suresh passes away in his hospital bed.]

Sanjay: "We have to be strong now."
